

#### .github/prompts/12-money-check.prompt.md

---mode: agentdescription: Batch 12. Check every agreed money case against the built rules, and fix rule bugs only. About 40K tokens.---
Build batch 12 only. No UI changes.
Read: `.github/prompts/PHASE2.md`, `src/domain/ledger.ts`, `src/domain/transfers.ts`, `src/adapters/file-ledger.ts`, `tests/ledger.test.ts`.Create: `tests/money-cases.test.ts`.
## Build
One table-driven test. Each case builds a small ledger and checks the results. Use the existing functions only.
| # | Case | Expect ||---|---|---|| 1 | $150 on your card: $100 House, $50 you | House owes you $100. Personal $100 || 2 | $60 on the House account, all House | No debt. Personal $30 || 3 | $40 on the House account, all you | You owe House $40. Personal $40 || 4 | $50 on your card, all for a friend | Friend owes you $50. Personal $0 || 5 | Friend paid $90 dinner, your share $30 | You owe the friend $30. Personal $30 || 6 | $150 on your card: $100 House, $50 friend. Friend pays you $20 | Friend owes you $30. House owes you $100. Personal $50 || 7 | $15.18 House spend, bank row $5.18, not reimbursable | House owes you $5.18. Personal $7.59 || 8 | $586.32 spend: $419.40 House, rest you | Personal $376.62 || 9 | $0.01 House spend | Personal $0.01 || 10 | House owes $100, then $20. House pays $110 | One open item of $10. Balance $10 || 11 | $100 House portion settled, then a $30 refund to your card | You owe House $30 || 12 | $200 from your account to the House account, confirmed as a contribution | No debt || 13 | House account pays a friend's $30 ticket | Between others: friend owes House $30. Your balances unchanged. Personal $0 || 14 | $80 spend from an import kept out of balances | No debt. Personal includes it |
## Fixes
- If a case fails, fix it in `ledger.ts` or `transfers.ts` only.- If a fix needs any other file, do not change it. List the case in `PROGRESS.md` and tell the user.- Never change an expected value to make a case pass.
## Done when
`npm test` passes. Then reply with a three-column table: case, pass or fixed, file changed. Update `PROGRESS.md`. Next is 13, or `H1` when the user has shared the history CSV header.

#### .github/prompts/13-activity-filters.prompt.md

---mode: agentdescription: Batch 13. Search, filters, sorting, filtered totals, and bulk edit in Activity. About 45K tokens.---
Build batch 13 only.
Read: `.github/prompts/PHASE2.md`, `src/domain/ledger.ts`, `src/adapters/file-ledger.ts`, `src/ui/LocalApp.tsx`, `src/ui/views/ActivityView.tsx`, `tests/ledger.test.ts`.Create: `src/domain/query.ts`.
## Build
1. `query.ts`.   - `EntryFilter`, all fields optional: `text`, `from`, `to`, `accountId`, `categoryId`, `entityId` (payer or any portion), `payerEntityId`, `kind`, `tag`, `counted` (true or false), `source` (`bank | manual | splitwise`, using the origin rule in `PHASE2.md`).   - `accountId` matches the entry's `accountId`, or the account of any of its bank rows.   - `text` matches the description, note, and tags, ignoring case.   - `filterEntries(ledger, filter)` returns entries newest first.   - `filteredTotals(entries)` returns the count, total cents, and personal and House cents using the report rule. Refunds count negative.2. `LocalApp.tsx`: keep `activityFilter` in state. Export `openActivity(filter)` through props so later views can jump to a filtered Activity.3. `ActivityView.tsx`.   - Replace the existing "Not counted toward balances" filter with the new `filters` bar: all fields, a Clear button, and a count of active filters.   - Sort by date or amount, either direction.   - A `summary-strip` for the filtered rows: count, total, Personal, House.   - Reuse the existing row checkboxes and Include/Exclude selected actions. Add a select-all for the filtered rows.   - Add bulk set category, add tag, and remove tag beside them. Show the count, and confirm before applying.   - Bulk edits change only those fields and set `updatedAt`.
## Tests
One test in `tests/ledger.test.ts`: filtering by an entity and a date range returns only entries with that entity as payer or in a portion, inside the range.
## Done when
`npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass. Update `PROGRESS.md`. Next is 14.

#### .github/prompts/14-review-speed.prompt.md

---mode: agentdescription: Batch 14. Split presets, keyboard review, bulk review, and one-step undo. About 40K tokens.---
Build batch 14 only.
Read: `.github/prompts/PHASE2.md`, `src/domain/ledger.ts`, `src/adapters/file-ledger.ts`, `src/ui/LocalApp.tsx`, `src/ui/views/ReviewView.tsx`, `src/ui/views/SpendForm.tsx`, `tests/ledger.test.ts`.
## Build
1. `ledger.ts`: `splitPreset(amountCents, payerEntityId, preset)`.   - `payer` puts the whole amount on the payer.   - `halfHouse` splits it between self and House, odd cent to self.   - `allHouse` puts it all on House.   - `entity` takes an `entityId` and puts it all on that entity.   - `equal` takes `entityIds` and splits evenly, leftover cents to the first, one cent each.2. `SpendForm.tsx`: preset buttons above the portion rows. Also offer "Last split on this account", stored as `lastSplitByAccount` in `file-ledger.ts` with the preset and entity ids, not amounts.3. `ReviewView.tsx`, keyboard.   - Up and Down, or `j` and `k`, move between rows.   - Then `s` spend, `i` income, `x` skip, `t` transfer, `e` settlement, `r` refund. Each key triggers the row's existing button: Transfer opens the manual picker, Settlement calls `onSettle(row)`, and Refund exists only for money in. A key with no button on that row does nothing.   - In the form, Enter saves and Escape cancels.   - Shortcuts are off while typing in an input. Show a one-line legend.4. `ReviewView.tsx`, bulk.   - Row checkboxes. "Skip selected".   - "Spend selected" with one preset and an optional category, applied to each row's own amount, with the payer from each row's account. Each entry gets its own `crypto.randomUUID()` and writes category memory the same way a single save does.   - Show the count and confirm.5. `LocalApp.tsx`, undo.   - Before any review or bulk action, keep the previous ledger in memory. Do it inside the existing `update`, through an optional `undoLabel` argument, so views do not keep their own copy.   - Show "Undo" in a `banner` for 10 seconds. One level only, not saved.
## Tests
One test: `equal` with $10.00 over three entities gives $3.34, $3.33, $3.33.
## Done when
`npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass. Update `PROGRESS.md`. Next is 15.

#### .github/prompts/15-rules.prompt.md

---mode: agentdescription: Batch 15. User rules for display names, category, split, and tags, with preview and source tracking. About 50K tokens.---
Build batch 15 only.
Read: `.github/prompts/PHASE2.md`, `src/domain/ledger.ts`, `src/domain/query.ts`, `src/adapters/file-ledger.ts`, `src/ui/LocalApp.tsx`, `src/ui/views/ReviewView.tsx`, `src/ui/views/SpendForm.tsx`, `tests/ledger.test.ts`.Create: `src/domain/rules.ts`, `src/ui/views/RulesView.tsx`.
## Build
1. `file-ledger.ts`, optional `rules`.   - Each rule: `id`, `name`, `order`, `enabled`, and `match`.     - `match`: `text`, `mode` (`contains | startsWith`, ignoring case), `accountId` (or null), `sign` (`out | in | any`), `minCents` and `maxCents` (or null).   - `action`: `displayName` (or null), `categoryId` (or null), `split` (a batch 14 preset, or null), and `tags`.   - Also `autoConfirm` (false) and `updatedAt`.   - An entry gets optional `source` (`manual | bank | splitwise | rule | memory | history`), `ruleId`, and `displayName`, copied from the rule when the entry is created. Old entries keep no `source`. Readers use the origin rule in `PHASE2.md`.   - In Review only, set `source` on new entries: `bank`, then `rule` or `memory` when one filled the row. Other views stay unchanged.   - `query.ts`: the `source` filter uses a stored `source` first, then the origin rule. `rule`, `memory`, and `history` count as `bank` for that filter.2. `rules.ts`.   - `firstRule(rules, row, account)` takes enabled rules by `order` and returns the first match.   - `autoConfirm` works only when the rule has a split.   - Rules are checked before category memory. Memory applies only when no rule matches.3. `ReviewView.tsx`.   - A matched row shows "By rule: name" and comes prefilled from the action.   - "Apply N auto rules" creates entries for matched rows with `autoConfirm`, with `source: "rule"` and `ruleId`.   - "Create rule from this row" opens `RulesView` with the description filled in.   - A display name shows beside the raw description in Review and Activity.4. `RulesView.tsx`.   - List the rules in order, with move up and down, enable, edit, and delete.   - While editing, preview the matching review rows: the count and the first 10.   - "Undo rule entries" removes the entries with that `ruleId` and clears their rows' `entryId`, after a confirm. Add Rules to the nav.
## Tests
One test: two rules match one row, and the lower `order` wins. A rule with `autoConfirm` and no split is not auto-confirmed.
## Done when
`npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass. Update `PROGRESS.md`. Next is 16.

#### .github/prompts/16-reports.prompt.md

---mode: agentdescription: Batch 16. Reports with Personal and Household scope, trends, categories, merchants, drill-down, and CSV export. About 50K tokens.---
Build batch 16 only.
Read: `.github/prompts/PHASE2.md`, `src/domain/ledger.ts`, `src/domain/query.ts`, `src/adapters/file-ledger.ts`, `src/ui/LocalApp.tsx`, `tests/ledger.test.ts`.Create: `src/domain/reports.ts`, `src/ui/views/ReportsView.tsx`.
## Build
1. `reports.ts`.   - Scope `personal`: self portions plus half of House portions, as now.   - Scope `household`: self portions plus all House portions.   - Refunds count negative in both scopes. Other people's and groups' portions are never included.   - `monthly(ledger, scope, months)`: per month, spending, refunds, and net.   - `byCategory(ledger, scope, from, to)`: category by month, with row and column totals.   - `topMerchants(ledger, scope, from, to, limit)`: grouped by the entry's `displayName`, or else the description in lowercase with digits removed and spaces collapsed.   - `cashFlow(ledger, from, to)`: income, transfers, and settlements in and out, kept separate from spending.2. `ReportsView.tsx`.   - A scope toggle and a date range, defaulting to the last 12 months.   - Four tables: Monthly, Categories, Merchants, Cash flow.   - Each amount is a button that calls `openActivity` with the matching filter.   - A month that overlaps `accountCoverage(ledger, accountId).gaps` for any account shows "Partial data".   - "Download CSV" exports the table on screen.   - Inline bars: you may add one `.report-bar` rule of at most 10 lines to `styles.css`. No chart library.   - Add Reports to the nav.
## Tests
One test: a month with a $100 House spend and a $20 self spend gives $70 personal and $120 household.
## Done when
`npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass. Update `PROGRESS.md`. Next is 17.

#### .github/prompts/17-health-backups.prompt.md

---mode: agentdescription: Batch 17. A health view of things needing attention, folder backups on save, and a migration hook. About 45K tokens.---
Build batch 17 only.
Read: `.github/prompts/PHASE2.md`, `src/domain/ledger.ts`, `src/adapters/file-ledger.ts`, `src/adapters/file-store.ts`, `src/ui/LocalApp.tsx`, `src/ui/views/DataView.tsx`, `tests/ledger.test.ts`.Create: `src/domain/health.ts`, `src/ui/views/HealthView.tsx`.
## Build
1. `health.ts`: `findIssues(ledger, today)` returns issues, each with `kind`, `count`, `detail`, and the view to open. Use the existing functions. Kinds:   - Rows waiting in review (no `entryId` or `settlementId`, not skipped), with the oldest date.   - A `checkpointDifferences(ledger, accountId)` result whose `differenceCents` is not zero.   - A gap from `accountCoverage(ledger, accountId).gaps`.   - An item from `openItems(ledger, entityId)` older than 60 days, per entity.   - A `splitwisePosts` item in `unknown` or `posting` state, or a `splitwiseInbox` item with status `new`, `changed`, or `deleted`.   - An amended amount with no note.   - A possible double entry: a manual entry and a bank-row entry on the same account, same date, same amount.2. `HealthView.tsx`: issues grouped by kind. Each opens its view. Show the issue count in the nav with `nav-count`.3. Backups, in `file-store.ts`.   - "Choose backup folder" uses `showDirectoryPicker`. Keep the handle in memory.   - On each `save` and `saveAs` with a folder chosen, also write `ledger-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.finance.json`. A failed backup shows a warning but never fails the save.   - Keep the newest 20 files matching that pattern. Delete older matches only.   - Without the API, say backups need Chrome or Edge.4. `DataView.tsx` gets optional props `onChooseBackupFolder` and `onRestore(ledger)`. "Restore from backup" picks a file, parses it with `parseLedger`, shows its counts (entries, rows, settlements), and calls `onRestore` after a confirm. `LocalApp` treats a restore like Open: it asks to discard unsaved changes first.5. `file-ledger.ts`: `migrate(raw)` runs inside `parseLedger`, before validation, and switches on `schemaVersion`. Version 1 passes through. A higher version is rejected with a readable message.
## Tests
One test: a ledger with one review row and a checkpoint difference of $5 reports both issues.
## Done when
`npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass. Update `PROGRESS.md`. Next is 18.

#### .github/prompts/18-splitwise-sync.prompt.md

---mode: agentdescription: Batch 18. Post settlements to Splitwise, apply Splitwise edits to entries, and check balances against Splitwise. About 45K tokens.---
Build batch 18 only.
Read: `.github/prompts/PHASE2.md`, `src/adapters/splitwise.ts`, `src/adapters/file-ledger.ts`, `src/domain/ledger.ts`, `src/ui/LocalApp.tsx`, `src/ui/views/SettleView.tsx`, `src/ui/views/ReviewView.tsx`, `src/ui/views/ActivityView.tsx`, `tests/splitwise.test.ts`.
This batch reads eight files. If context runs long after step 2, hand off as `copilot-instructions.md` says.
## API
All in this prompt. Do not fetch the docs.
- A payment is `POST /create_expense` with `payment=true`. The person who paid has `paid_share` equal to the cost. The person who received it has `owed_share` equal to the cost.- `get_friends` returns `friends[].balance: [{ currency_code, amount }]`. A positive AUD amount means they owe you. If the field is missing, hide the balance check.
## Build
0. `file-ledger.ts`: a Splitwise post's `entryId` becomes nullable, and it gets an optional `settlementId`. Exactly one of the two is set. Existing code that reads `entryId` must handle null.1. `splitwise.ts`: `buildPayment(settlement, entity, memberId, youId)` is pure.   - Person: the member is the friend.   - Group: the user picks the member.   - Direction comes from the settlement.2. `SettleView.tsx`.   - After saving a settlement with a linked entity, offer "Also record in Splitwise". That opens the same confirm panel as an expense: editable date, description, and amount, then who paid and who is owed. A group asks which member before the panel opens. Nothing is sent until the user confirms. Cancel posts nothing.   - Use the batch 11 and 11c post states and the same save-before-call, with `settlementId` on the post instead of `entryId`. `SettleView` gets the same `saveNow` prop that `ActivityView` has.   - Never offer it for a settlement that came from Splitwise, meaning one with `splitwisePaymentId`.3. `ReviewView.tsx`, Splitwise inbox items.   - `changed`: show the item's `previous` values and the new date, description, cost, and your owed share side by side. "Apply to entry" updates the linked entry's amount, date, and self portion, and keeps the rest on the entity.   - `deleted`: "Keep out of balances" sets `countsTowardDebt: false` and adds the tag `deleted-in-splitwise`. "Delete entry" deletes it after a confirm.4. `SettleView.tsx`, balance check for a linked person. `getFriends` returns an optional `balance` on each friend (extend the type): the Splitwise balance against the local balance, and the difference. Explain that a difference means an unmatched entry or settlement. Never change anything automatically.
## Tests
One test in `tests/splitwise.test.ts`: a $25 "they paid you" settlement gives a payment where the friend's paid share is 25.00 and owed share 0.00, and your paid share is 0.00 and owed share 25.00.
Before wiring the button, ask the user to record a $1 payment in the Splitwise app and fetch it with `get_expenses`. If its shares differ from this rule, stop and ask.
## Done when
`npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass. With your key, record one small payment and delete it in Splitwise. Update `PROGRESS.md`. Next is 19.

#### .github/prompts/H1-anz-credit-history.prompt.md

---mode: agentdescription: One-time import of the hand-kept ANZ credit history. Dev-only, removed afterward. About 40K tokens.---
One-time job. One answer below is still blank. If it is blank when you start, stop and ask. Do not guess it.
Read: `.github/prompts/PHASE2.md`, `src/domain/ledger.ts`, `src/domain/value.ts`, `src/adapters/file-ledger.ts`, `src/ui/LocalApp.tsx`, `src/ui/views/DataView.tsx`, `tests/ledger.test.ts`.
Needs batch 06 (categories, tags, note, and `extraReimbursable`). If `categoryMemory` is missing from `file-ledger.ts`, stop and say "Run 06 first". Add optional `historyKey` to the entry schema. If batch 15 is done, also set `source: "history"`.Create: `src/domain/history-import.ts`, `src/ui/views/HistoryImportView.tsx`.
## Fill in
From the user. Never copy real rows into code, tests, or chat.
1. Header row, exact names: `Date`, `Description`, `Debit($AUD)`, `Status`, `SubType`, `Group`, `Our share`.2. Date: column `Date`. Accept `D/M/YYYY` and `YYYY-MM-DD`. Anything else is a problem row.3. Description: column `Description`.4. Amount: column `Debit($AUD)`. A positive number is a spend, money out. A negative number is money in. Empty is a problem row.5. House portion: column `Our share`, and it is the whole House portion, not your half. Empty means no House portion.6. Category: column `SubType`, when it is not one of the association words below. Match or create the category by name, ignoring case.7. No note column. Tag every created entry `history`.8. Gift card or points: no column. When `Our share` is greater than the debit, the debit is the bank amount and `Our share` is the House portion. The difference is an amended amount, note "Gift card or points", `extraReimbursable: false`.9. Settled: column `Status`. `Settled` means already settled, so `countsTowardDebt: false`. Blank means still open, so `countsTowardDebt: true`.10. Date range and overlap with imported ANZ CSVs: not stated. Keep the match rule below. Show the matched count before commit.11. Card payments are not spends. They are the association value `Payment`.12. Association value, one of `Friend`, `Group`, `House`, `Payment`, `Personal`, `Refund`, `Trip`, or blank. Blank means not associated yet, so leave the row out and list it as pending. Column name: 
## How a row is split
The payer is self and the account is the chosen ANZ credit account. Create a person or a group when the name is new. Match names ignoring case.
- `Personal`: House gets `Our share`, and you get the rest. With no `Our share`, it is all yours.- `House`: House gets `Our share` when present, otherwise the whole debit. Any remainder is yours.- `Friend`: the person named in `Group` gets the debit minus `Our share`. House gets `Our share`. A blank `Group` is a problem row.- `Group` or `Trip`: same, with a group entity named from `Group`. A trip is a group.- `Refund`: a refund entry. Portions follow the same split. It counts negative. Do not look for the original spend.- `Payment`: not an entry. A matched bank row is marked skipped. Nothing is added to spending or debt.- Blank association: pending. Do not create an entry.
`Settled` and blank status apply on top of every case except `Payment` and pending. A settled friend expense creates no live debt. An open one does.
## Match existing bank rows
Match a row to an unclassified bank row on the chosen account: same date and same absolute amount, or a unique same-amount row within 2 days. Link it with `bankRowIds`. With no match, create the entry with no bank row. Never match a row that already has an entry.
Each entry stores `historyKey`, the SHA-256 of the raw line. A key already present is skipped, so running twice adds nothing.
Never log or print row contents. Show counts, and the first 10 rows of each group, on screen only.
## Build
1. `history-import.ts`: `planHistoryImport(text, ledger, accountId)` is pure. It returns `{ matched, created, skipped, pending, problems }`. `applyHistoryImport(plan, ledger)` returns the next ledger.2. `HistoryImportView.tsx`: shown only when `import.meta.env.DEV` is true, rendered inside `DataView` below its existing content. `DataView` gets optional `ledger` and `update` props to pass through.   - Pick the account, choose the file, then show the counts and the first 10 of each group.   - Problem rows block the commit unless "Skip problem rows" is ticked. Pending rows are reported and are not imported.   - Commit, then say "Save the file now".3. After the user has saved, delete both files. Keep the `history` tag and `historyKey` on the entries.
## Tests
One test in `tests/ledger.test.ts`, synthetic rows only.
- A `Personal` row, debit 30.00, `Our share` 10.00, status `Settled`: House portion 10.00, yours 20.00, and it does not count toward balances.- The same row with a blank status does count.- Running the plan again adds nothing.
## Done when
`npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass. The user imports the real file in `npm run dev`, checks the counts, and saves. Then delete the two files and update `PROGRESS.md`.
